│ Programs:
FieldDesk — Help & Shortcuts
Field Map — Editing Tools
Draw FieldClick map to add vertices. Double-click to close the polygon.
Edit BoundaryClick and drag vertices to move them. Click a vertex then press Delete/Backspace to remove it. Click the midpoint marker (lighter dot between vertices) to add a new vertex.
Edit Planting BorderClick a planting in the side panel → Edit Border. Drag vertices to reshape. The sibling planting auto-updates to fill the remainder. If no border exists, the field boundary is auto-copied (or field minus siblings for Unassigned plantings).
✂ SimplifyWhile editing a planting border, click ✂ Simplify in the toolbar to reduce vertex count. Removes tiny jags and sliver fragments from complex shapefiles.
⬚ Lasso DeleteWhile editing a planting border, click ⬚ Lasso Delete then draw a box around vertices to remove them all at once. Useful for cleaning up border edges with too many points.
Slice FieldDraw a line across the field to split it into two planting zones. The line must cross both sides of the boundary. Click Save when satisfied with the two halves.
Upload PlantingUse Import → Shapefile to upload a .zip containing a planting boundary shapefile. The geometry will appear as a planting zone on the field map.
Program Scope
🌾 Whole FieldProgram uses full field acres for reports. Click the badge to switch to planting-only.
🔶 PlantingProgram targets a specific crop planting — reports use planting acres, not field acres. Click to switch back to whole field. Use "Apply to All → Fields with Crop" to auto-target plantings.
⛬ Treatment AreaProgram targets a drawn treatment area within the field.
Keyboard Shortcuts
Ctrl+ZUndo last action
EscCancel current map tool / close panel
DeleteRemove selected vertex (while editing boundary)
Reports
Coverage GapsReports → "⚠ Coverage Gaps" shows which fields are missing programs and which products are missing coverage. Also detects scope mismatches (whole-field vs planting). Field names are clickable to jump directly to the field for fixing.
Program Field TrackerReports → "Program Field Tracker" → select a program. Check/uncheck fields to apply or remove.
Product NeedsShows total product quantities across all fields. VRT fields show weighted-average rates. Blend programs show both per-ingredient and total blend quantities.
Common Tasks
Add planting zoneField Map → click field → click "+ Add" button in the plantings panel, or use the Slice tool.
Upload field boundaryImport tab → drag a .zip shapefile. Or: Field Map → click field → Boundary ▾ → Import for This Field.
Upload planting shapefileField Map → click field → + Add ▾ → Upload Shapefile. The planting boundary is clipped to the field border.
Fix orphaned programsSettings → "Fix Orphaned Program Assignments" to re-link programs where the grower assignment doesn't match the field.
Split-planted fieldUse Slice to split a field into crop plantings. Each planting gets its own border, crop, variety, and programs. The Unassigned planting auto-fills the remaining area.
